CustomField.description: S3P-1495 Checked by Sales reps on newly sold Opportunities to flag that the agency does not want to be enrolled in SmartBidding pricing. Read by the SmartBidding bulk enrollment process to exclude the opportunity from opt-in. TEMPORARY FIELD - only applies to opportunities sold between the start of B2B Communications and the SmartBidding activation date. Scheduled for removal after that window closes; confirm with Yancy/Dan before deleting.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this box if the agency has asked not to be enrolled in SmartCampaigns. This will exclude them from the bulk SmartCampaigns opt-in.
CustomField.label: Opt-Out of SmartCampaigns
